label: Q-01
title: Cutover core's 'read live' rescue amounts and post-conditions (mintDebt==0, old pooler drained, _assertRetired) run only in forge simulation; interim index-4 mints before step 10 leave unswept sUSDS on the paused old pooler, and a re-enabled donation could revert the step-11 USDS rescue
rootCause: ForgeLocalPassPrecedesBroadcast: amounts read in simulation are baked into calldata; every require between external calls is simulation-only, while index 4 still dispatches to the old pooler until step 10 is mined.
description: The 'read live after step 10' amounts are read in simulation and baked into the rescue calldata. The drain checks at L532-535 and in _assertRetired run only in simulation. Until the step-10 tx is mined, index 4 still dispatches to the old pooler, and every interim mint wraps USDS into sUSDS ON the old pooler (BalancerPoolerV2._dispatch). That sUSDS is not covered by the baked rescue. It stays on the old pooler after step 12 pauses it. The mint rate since the 2026-10-01 holding pattern is ~1,957 sUSDS in ~12 days. Conditional brick: if the owner re-enables the donation on the old pooler before the cutover (live batchDonationSize is 0, so this does NOT apply to today's config), an interim mint's PSM sweep consumes the parked USDS. The on-chain balance can then fall below the baked usdsRescued, so the step-11 USDS rescue reverts. The broadcast halts before step 12, leaving the old pooler unpaused with NFTMinterV2 still its minter. PATTERN-003 adds: the step-7 mintDebt==0 check and the step-4/5/6 baked bal/bptIn/sAmt/pAmt are the same simulation-only mechanism (the step-5/6 facet is carried by DEDUP-001 and not double-counted here).

attackPath: None - ordinary index-4 mints between simulation and step 10 being mined
failureScenario.attackVector: None. Ordinary index-4 mints during the multi-tx broadcast window.
failureScenario.likelihood: high for residue (dust-scale); conditional step-11 revert needs owner to re-enable donation (live batchDonationSize = 0)
failureScenario.externalRequirements: Index-4 mints during the broadcast window

impact: No loss: rescueERC20 is onlyOwner and not pause-gated, so residue is recoverable (opportunity cost per ECON Q4). Retired pooler silently keeps protocol sUSDS that in-script post-conditions claim is zero; conditional step-11 revert (only if donation re-enabled; live batchDonationSize = 0) halts before step 12.
assetImpact: Small sUSDS residue (index-4 mints during the broadcast window, ~6.8 sUSDS/hour at the current rate) left on the paused old pooler; recoverable via onlyOwner, non-pause-gated rescueERC20.

evidence.notes: Not separately fork-tested in tier3; supporting static instances (simulation-only strict equalities SLITHER-003/006/008/012/013/014/016/017/020) logged as context in dedup-log.

recommendation: Run step-11 rescue in a second invocation after step 10 is mined, or have story 103's verify assert old-pooler sUSDS/USDS == 0 and mintDebt == 0 live after broadcast and sweep residue.

classification.justification: State-handling defect: post-conditions (mintDebt==0, old pooler drained, _assertRetired) are simulation-only, so the script claims a zero balance that may not hold on chain. The residue is dust-scale for a minutes-long window and fully recoverable, and the step-11 revert branch is not reachable under today's config. This matches the class precedent Q-01 9fa8eee3010e (ForgeLocalPassPrecedesBroadcast, QA) and is not tested on fork. QA, not Low: no loss, no live trigger for the halt branch. Recommend story 103's :verify assert old-pooler balances and mintDebt live after broadcast.
